title: Hollow Orchard
direction: Initial hypothesis: playful-dark tactile electronic / organic hybrid

patches.wood: inharmonic decaying resonator partials, filtered felt noise attack, soft saturation
patches.rubber: triangle/saw blend, falling pitch envelope, low-pass resonant coloration
patches.bass: rounded triangle plus fundamental, low-pass, mono
patches.air: band-limited noise with slow amplitude modulation
patches.drums: pitch-decay kick, filtered noise / resonator rim, short noisy hats

loop_processing: Circular event tails and circular multi-tap room/delay; no endpoint fades. Each loop is a periodic signal.
gain: One global gain shared by all assets and stems; no limiter
